message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have an operation available that lets me top‑up your fuel tank—there’s no “refuel” command in this environment.  
However, I can help you prepare everything else before you head out:

| Action | Command |
|--------|---------|
| Engage the hand‑brake / parking brake | `activateParkingBrake({"mode":"engage"})` |
| Lock all four doors | `lockDoors({ "unlock":false, "door":["driver","passenger","rear_left","rear_right"] })` |
| Start the engine | `startEngine({ "ignitionMode":"START" })` |

Let me run those commands now so your car is ready once you’re back at the pump.

```json
{
  "commentary": [
    {"name":"activateParkingBrake","arguments":{"mode":"engage"}},
    {"name":"lockDoors","arguments":{"unlock":false,"door":["driver","passenger","rear_left","rear_right"]}},
    {"name":"startEngine","arguments":{"ignitionMode":"START"}}
  ]
}
```

Once you’ve added the 30 gal of fuel yourself, just let me know when you’re ready to continue!

We have no direct function to refuel. There's no function like fill_fuel. So we cannot actually add gasoline. We can respond explaining limitation. Also need to engage parking brake? They said handbrake pulled up - that's parking brake. Use activateParkingBrake with mode engage. Lock doors via lockDoors unlocking false? Actually lockDoors expects unlock bool. To lock, unlock=false. door array includes driver passenger rear_left rear_right. Start engine using startEngine with ignitionMode "START". Provide steps. But can't physically add fuel. We'll explain inability. Let's do it.
